powers.label: Warp
powers.note: ME3's Warp (SFXPowerCustomAction_Warp: CastSound, ImpactSound), plus the cast clip's cloth foley (HMM_BC_ThrowBiotic's SFXAnimNotify_RaceWwiseEvent).

powers.label: Lift
powers.note: ME3 has no Lift; its Pull (SFXPowerCustomAction_Pull: CastSound, ImpactSound) floats the target the same way, so Lift sounds and looks like it (its lift crust is named here: only code references it).

powers.label: Overload
powers.note: ME3's Overload (SFXPowerCustomAction_Overload). Its class default names no impact or projectile role: the burst on the target is CE_HitWallTemplate (also the chain's CE_ImpactTemplate), the wrist flash CE_ReleaseEffectTemplate, and the caster's omni-tool the arm half of CE_CasterCrustTemplate's RvrClientEffectMulti (the hand half is an import). Plus the tech cast clip's cloth foley (HMM_BC_RifleTechTool's SFXAnimNotify_RaceWwiseEvents, in SFXGame.pcc).

powers.label: Omni-tool
powers.note: Not a power: the omni-tool players use while their menu is open. ME3's left-arm hologram (OmniTool_LeftFull_VCFX_M: the arm and hand loops) and the sounds ME3's HMM_WI_OmniTool clips cue (AnimNotify_WwiseEvents: start and beeps on OmniEnter, end on OmniExit).
